note: Unique sample code with assay suffix '_18Suni'.
Bore (well) name; add as locality to geo_loc_name (Location is the term); also holds control labels (EC, Blank, POS).
Year only (2020, 2021); ISO 8601 allows a year-truncated date; NA for lab controls.
Island name; format as 'Australia: Western Australia, Barrow Island' plus the bore.
Water volume filtered in mL (up to 1000 from a 1 L bailer); set unit mL; NA for sediment and lab controls.
GW -> ground water [ENVO:01001004], Sediment -> sediment [ENVO:00002007]; control labels go to neg_cont_type or pos_cont_type.
Shallow = plastic bailer in upper 2 m, Deeper = steel bailer at bore bottom, plus Sediment, Passive and control labels.
Sample -> 'sample'; Control -> 'negative control' (the Positive row -> 'positive control'); Mock -> 'positive control'.
Haul-net stygofauna abundance per bore; study result, not sample metadata.
Haul-net stygofauna taxon richness per bore; study result, not sample metadata.
Reads per sample, probably after filtering; experimentRunMetadata.
Codes 0/1/2 for the before/after haul-net sampling test; study design variable.
Decimal latitude of the bore; datum not stated (check WGS84 vs GDA); NA for controls.
Decimal longitude of the bore; datum not stated (check WGS84 vs GDA); NA for controls.
Bore depth in m; water column depth = Depth minus SWL; also the sampling depth of 'Deeper' samples.
Standing water level in m below ground; combine with Depth for tot_depth_water_col and shallow sample depths.
Bore casing material; no FAIRe term.
Bore casing diameter (mm); no FAIRe term.
Bore screen slot orientation; no FAIRe term.
Bore screen slot size (mm); no FAIRe term.
